Movies and series streamed from torrents while they download — on Android phones, Android TV and Windows.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Watchly-2.0.0-phone-arm64-v8a.apk` | Android phones — almost every phone from the last several years |
| `Watchly-2.0.0-phone-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit Android phones |
| `Watchly-2.0.0-tv-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Android TV — most televisions and TV boxes are 32-bit |
| `Watchly-2.0.0-tv-arm64-v8a.apk` | Android TV on 64-bit hardware (Shield, newer boxes) |
| `Watchly-2.0.0-windows-x64.exe` | Windows 10/11 x64 — one file, no install, no .NET needed |

## What's new since 1.1.0

The phone and TV apps are rebuilt in native Kotlin and share one streaming core.

**Streaming**
- Resume points are tracked by byte position, so they land where you stopped
- Another release of the same title resumes where the last one left off (phone, TV, Windows)
- Better recovery from stuck pieces; fewer stalls at "finding peers" and "starting playback"

**Phone**
- New native app: full touch player with an icon-only bar, a corner lock and a brightness slider
- Double-tap to skip with a YouTube-style ripple; a short buzz when holding to speed up
- Downloads: whole seasons in episode order, each episode skippable, a season-pack picker
- Google Cast, open in another player, subtitle delay
- Home: tall poster rows, bigger shelf cards, no repeated titles; search filters
- One entry per title with Resume / Start over; Library rows; sliding tabs
- Title pages: cast with photos, an awards card, tidier episode lists, swipe-down sheets
- Light and dark theme; PIN to unlock; backup; new-episodes shelf
- Source rows scroll to show the full release name
- Engine log file for troubleshooting

**TV**
- Rebuilt in Kotlin with Compose; Media3 player with libVLC as the fallback
- Seeking no longer stalls on buffering, and the slider holds its target
- Fixed corrupted playback from reads past the downloaded pieces
- Playback pauses on Home; elapsed time shown; smoother scrolling; screen saver no longer breaks resume

**Windows**
- Pause card matches the TV's
- The SubDL subtitle key is read correctly
